title: Coast Guard Top Videos of 2011: North Head Cliff Rescue
description: A Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew from Air Station Astoria, Ore., responds to an injured climber near North Head Lighthouse near Ilwaco, Wash., July 7, 2011. U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 1st Class Shawn Eggert. Also available in high definition.
keywords: cliff rescue, MH-60 Jayhawk, Coast Guard, High Definition
